description: Pre-screening protocol modelled on the DECLARE-TIMI 58 trial (dapagliflozin) and CANVAS Programme (canagliflozin). Targets adults with Type 2 diabetes mellitus and suboptimal glycaemic control, with established or high cardiovascular risk, excluding patients with severe nephropathy. Primary endpoint: MACE (major adverse cardiovascular events). CGM criteria reflect the HbA1c inclusion range used in the original trials (6.5%–12.0% HbA1c, expressed here as GMI equivalent).

inclusion_criteria.human_rationale: SGLT2 inhibitors are indicated for T2DM. The DECLARE-TIMI 58 and CANVAS programmes exclusively enrolled T2DM patients; T1DM patients have different glycaemic profiles and a different risk-benefit calculus for SGLT2 inhibition (DKA risk).

A minimum 2-year disease duration ensures patients have established T2DM rather than newly-diagnosed cases that may respond to lifestyle alone, and is consistent with the enrolment criteria in CANVAS (established T2DM at high CV risk).

DECLARE-TIMI 58 required HbA1c >= 6.5%; CANVAS required >= 7.0%. A GMI floor of 7.0% selects patients with suboptimal control who are most likely to benefit from the glucose-lowering and cardiorenal protective effects of canagliflozin.

DECLARE-TIMI 58 capped HbA1c at 12.0%; CANVAS at 10.5%. A GMI ceiling excludes severely uncontrolled patients who require intensified insulin therapy first and for whom a single SGLT2 inhibitor is unlikely to be the primary intervention. 10.5% aligns with CANVAS.

DECLARE-TIMI 58 enrolled patients aged >= 40 years with atherosclerotic CVD risk factors, or >= 55 years with established CVD. A minimum age of 40 reflects the target population for cardiorenal protection trials.

exclusion_criteria.human_rationale: CANVAS and DECLARE-TIMI 58 excluded patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2 (severe CKD) because SGLT2 inhibitors require adequate renal function for their glucose-lowering mechanism and may worsen acute kidney injury in severely impaired kidneys. The has_nephropathy flag here proxies for clinically significant nephropathy that would contraindicate SGLT2 use.

exclusion_criteria.human_label: No severe hypoglycaemic events in monitoring period
exclusion_criteria.human_rationale: Severe hypoglycaemia (requiring third-party assistance) indicates brittle glycaemic control or excessive insulin dosing that must be addressed before adding an SGLT2 inhibitor. It also raises DKA risk in combination therapy, and is a safety stopping criterion in both DECLARE-TIMI 58 and CANVAS.
